title: ziziphora clinopodioides subsp. filicaulis
intro: Ziziphora clinopodioides subsp. filicaulis, commonly known as mountain mint, is a species of flowering plant in the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, colds, and respiratory infections, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Ziziphora clinopodioides subsp. filicaulis include antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its medicinal value. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, such as menthone and limonene, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
